gloss: to make clear; to reveal; to clarify

definitions.gloss: to make clear; to reveal; to clarify
definitions.explanation: To bring something to light or make a fact, truth, or situation clearly known. Often used in formal or investigative contexts.

examples.japanese: {原因|げんいん}を{明|あき}らかにする。
{調査|ちょうさ}で{事実|じじつ}が{明|あき}らかになった。
examples.english: The facts came to light through the investigation.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}は{方針|ほうしん}を{明|あき}らかにする{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The government needs to make its policy clear.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}によって、{新|あたら}しい{事実|じじつ}が{明|あき}らかにされた。
examples.english: New facts were revealed through the research.

notes:
A common expression formed from {明|あき}らか (clear, obvious) + にする (to make). The intransitive counterpart {明|あき}らかになる (to become clear) is equally important.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {原因|げんいん}を{明|あき}らかにする: to clarify the cause
- {事実|じじつ}を{明|あき}らかにする: to reveal the facts
- {真相|しんそう}を{明|あき}らかにする: to uncover the truth
- {立場|たちば}を{明|あき}らかにする: to make one's position clear
- {方針|ほうしん}を{明|あき}らかにする: to clarify a policy

TRANSITIVE VS. INTRANSITIVE:
- {明|あき}らかにする: to make clear (someone reveals it) — transitive
- {明|あき}らかになる: to become clear (it comes to light on its own) — intransitive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {解明|かいめい}する: to elucidate — more technical/scientific
- はっきりさせる: to make clear — more colloquial
- {暴|あば}く: to expose — implies uncovering something hidden or scandalous
